title: 3828. Final Element After Subarray Deletions

examples.explanation: One valid optimal strategy: Alice removes [1], array becomes [5, 2]. Bob removes [5], array becomes [2]. Thus, the answer is 2.
Alice removes [3], leaving the array [7]. Since Bob cannot play a turn now, the answer is 7.
